mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_messages (id, tenant_id, phone_enc, phone_masked, text, purpose, encoding, segments, status, error, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{phoneEnc}, #{phoneMasked}, #{text}, #{purpose}, #{encoding}, #{segments}, #{status}, #{error}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.slug, t.display_name, count(*) AS messages, coalesce(sum(m.segments) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'SENT'), 0) AS segments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM sms_messages m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.created_at >= #{from} AND m.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY t.id, t.slug, t.display_name ORDER BY segments DESC, messages DESC, t.slug
